subject: Azure offer productionization & publisher enablement
messages:
From: Alex Duran <alex.duran@contoso-cloud.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@cloudops.example.com
Date: 2028-06-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New Azure listing — production readiness questions

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the intro call earlier. Contoso is ready to move our offer from trial to published in the Azure Marketplace. Before we request publication and co-sell enablement, can you confirm the productionization checklist you need from us? High level asks from our side:

- Publisher account proof and tenant claims
- Offer manifest and SKU definitions (we have draft attached)
- Technical validation for SaaS offer (redirect URI, SSO proof)
- Any co-sell paperwork or publisher-side enablement steps on the MS portal

We also have a short runbook for the app containerization and would like Redwood to validate runtime compatibility and any specific Azure validation artifacts you require.

Attached: contoso-publisher-proof.pdf (org docs), offer-manifest-v2.json (draft)

Can we align on required artifacts and an approximate timeline for validation + publishing?

Best,
Alex
Director, Cloud Partnerships
Contoso Cloud
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Duran <alex.duran@contoso-cloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New Azure listing — production readiness questions

Alex — thanks for the clear list and for sending the artifacts. Quick responses that should help unblock you: 

1) Publisher account proof: the PDF is good for our initial pass. We will need the tenant ID and a screenshot of the Publisher Center account (showing email & publisher name) for the Marketplace submission.
2) Offer manifest: offer-manifest-v2.json looks mostly OK; our product team will request a couple of SKU metadata tweaks (pricing tags + telemetry hooks).
3) Technical validation: Redwood requires the following for SaaS offers: redirect URI proof, sample auth flow log (trace), and a test tenant we can call during validation. If SSO is in play, include SAML metadata or OIDC config.
4) Co-sell: the standard flow is to publish the offer, then request co-sell enablement through the Partner Center. We can help with the Partner Center steps and prepare co-sell materials (one-pager + architecture diagram).

Proposed timeline:
- Today (Jun 18): we review artifacts and flag missing pieces
- Jun 19–20: Redwood tech validation run (internal owners Karthik/Jonas)
- Jun 21: joint submission to Partner Center (if validation passes)

Action items for Contoso: provide publisher account screenshot, a short auth trace (anonymized), and a test tenant service principal by end of day Jun 19. I'll assign internal owners below and follow up with a short checklist.

Cheers,
Naomi
Sr. Marketplace Partnerships | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Duran <alex.duran@contoso-cloud.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New Azure listing — production readiness questions

On Mon, Jun 18, 2028 at 11:03 AM Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Alex — thanks for the clear list and for sending the artifacts. Quick responses that should help unblock you:

Thanks — quick technical note from our validation checklist:

- Redirect URI: verify the redirect URI for the SaaS app is HTTPS and listed in the OIDC client config. We need a curl-based token exchange example (no secrets in email).
- Telemetry hooks: include a basic events endpoint that returns 200 for a sample payload; this accelerates our smoke tests.
- Runtime compatibility: confirm the container base image and GPU requirements. If you require GPU, we need an environment matrix so we can map SKU runtimes to Azure VM sizes.

Soojin will own the Partner Center submission with Contoso once we have the screenshots and test tenant. Jonas and I will run the tech validation (Jun 19–20).

--
Karthik
Lead Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: publisher-account-screenshot.png (image/png)]
From: Alex Duran <alex.duran@contoso-cloud.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-19T14:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New Azure listing — production readiness questions

Thanks team — attaching the publisher screenshot and a short anonymized auth trace. Also including a sample service principal for the test tenant (we created a scoped SP with minimal permissions).

Attachments: publisher-account-screenshot.png, auth-trace.txt

Notes:
- Container base: linux/amd64, no GPU required for standard SKUs.
- Telemetry: /v1/events returns 200 on POST with JSON body; we added a health endpoint at /health.

If you need anything else, ping me. We'll be ready for the Partner Center submission on Jun 21 if validation is green.

Alex
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Duran <alex.duran@contoso-cloud.com>, MS Publisher Support <microsoft-publisher-support@microsoft.com>
Date: 2028-06-21T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New Azure listing — production readiness questions

All validation checks passed on our side — quick summary for the record and Partner Center submission: 

- Publisher proof & screenshot: verified (matches tenant ID).
- Offer manifest: minor SKU metadata updates applied (pricing tags normalized).
- Auth flow: redirect URI & token exchange validated with test SP.
- Telemetry/health endpoints: smoke tests green.
- Container/runtime: linux/amd64 confirmed, no GPU required.

Next steps (today):
1) I will initiate the Partner Center submission and attach the final manifest.
2) Naomi will request co-sell enablement after publish (sends one-pager + architecture diagram).
3) Contoso to sign the standard co-sell agreement in DocuSign (link sent separately).

MS Publisher Support — if you see any missing pieces on your side, please advise; otherwise we will proceed with submission this afternoon.

Thanks everyone — smooth run.

Soojin Lee
Marketplace Ops Lead | Redwood Inference
[Related: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Marketplace/OfferSubmission]
